<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 132.43, 130.27, 129.30, 126.70, 126.66, and 123.57 ppm – six distinct aromatic carbon signals. Therefore, the compound contains six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
